checks.name: held-out-learned-reuse
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-core --test harness_boundary strengthened_path_fires_on_later_input -- --exact

findings: The shared world now contains only sensors, motors, nearness, and typed input targets; generic junctions, ports, links, triggers, and motor internals are absent.
The compact adapter build is a direct motor loop followed by a sensor attachment loop and no longer infers motor structure from thresholds or links.

All fixed and deterministic shared scenarios pass through the old harness with effects, causes, times, quietness, learned reuse, checkpoint replay, observer purity, construction reversal, distance controls, and dormant sensors preserved.
All 77 active held-out legacy regressions pass and the same two adversarial tests remain intentionally ignored.
residual_uncertainty: The compact body retains its previously observed behavioral result: quiet and distant controls pass, while local action formation remains absent and blocks later learning comparisons.
The old adapter still contains necessarily private legacy placement, region, outcome-source, identity, and trace-normalization details.
